text: Oryx's war-wide count of Russian Raptor boats is 3 destroyed and 2 damaged.
notes: war-wide count, not specific to the island

text: On 24 Feb 2022 the cruiser Moskva and the patrol ship Vasily Bykov spent the whole day demanding over Channel 16 that the Zmiinyi Island garrison surrender.
The Zmiinyi Island garrison on 24 Feb 2022 numbered about 80: border guards, marines of the 35th Brigade and a few others.
Around 18:00 on 24 Feb 2022 a Zmiinyi Island border guard told the "Russian warship" to go f— itself.

After a day of naval gunfire and Su-27/Su-34 air strikes on 24 Feb 2022, contact with Zmiinyi Island was lost about an hour after the 18:00 reply, and the whole garrison and the island's civilians were captured.
First reports had the whole Zmiinyi Island garrison dead.
The 'Russian warship' radio audio from Zmiinyi Island was published on the night of 24–25 Feb 2022 and became the war's rallying cry.
The 'Russian warship' radio reply from Zmiinyi Island became a Ukrainian postage stamp.
The Zmiinyi Island prisoners came home over more than three years of exchanges, the last on 23 Jul 2025.
On 13 Apr 2022 a Ukrainian Navy coastal battery in southern Odesa Oblast fired two R-360 Neptune missiles at the cruiser Moskva about 120 km offshore.

observations.subject: Moskva distance from shore when engaged

text: In April 2022 the Moskva was the Black Sea Fleet flagship and its long-range air-defence umbrella.
On 13 Apr 2022 low cloud hid the Moskva from aircraft and satellites, but the Neptune battery's ordinary radar reached it anyway, apparently ducted under the cloud.
A satellite radar image at 18:52 on 13 Apr 2022 caught the burning Moskva at 45°10′43″N 30°55′31″E, about 80 nmi south of Odesa.
Russia blamed the loss of the Moskva on a fire and an ammunition explosion and said the ship sank under tow "in stormy sea".
The cruiser Moskva sank on 14 Apr 2022.
The US confirmed that two Neptune missiles hit the Moskva.
Without the Moskva, Zmiinyi Island became an outpost Russia could not cover.
Through May 2022 Ukrainian Navy Bayraktar TB2s destroyed Zmiinyi Island's Tor launchers and picked off the Raptor boats, a Serna landing craft and a Mi-8 bringing replacements and troops.
A HUR-led helicopter assault on Zmiinyi Island in early May 2022 was called off.
From mid-June 2022 Ukraine switched to starving and shelling the Russian garrison on Zmiinyi Island.
On 17 Jun 2022 Harpoon missiles sank the Russian tug Vasily Bekh on its way to Zmiinyi Island.
On 20 Jun 2022 Ukrainian strikes hit the occupied gas rigs known as the "Boiko towers".
From 21 to 30 Jun 2022 the prototype Bohdana howitzer, CAESAR and Uragan fired on Zmiinyi Island from the Danube-delta shore.
On 30 Jun 2022 Russia evacuated the last troops from Zmiinyi Island in two speedboats.
Russia called its 30 Jun 2022 withdrawal from Zmiinyi Island a "goodwill gesture".
Ukrainian troops planted the flag on Zmiinyi Island on 7 Jul 2022.
Zmiinyi Island fell on 24 Feb 2022, the same day it was attacked: the garrison refused to surrender, survived the bombardment and was captured.
The Zmiinyi Island post commander said there were "no casualties after the shelling" on 24 Feb 2022.
About 80 personnel plus civilians were captured on Zmiinyi Island on 24 Feb 2022, per Ukrainian sources.
Russia claimed it captured 82 Ukrainians on Zmiinyi Island on 24 Feb 2022.
The "13 dead heroes" of Zmiinyi Island were a myth.
On 13–14 Apr 2022 two Neptune hits on the Moskva caused a fire and ammunition explosions; a tow failed and the ship sank early on 14 Apr.
The Moskva wreck lies about 80 nmi from Odesa in 45–50 m of water.
The Russian MoD said in April 2022 that the Moskva sinking left 1 dead, 27 missing and 396 rescued.

On 7–8 May 2022 two more Russian Raptor boats were hit at Zmiinyi Island; Ukraine claimed two destroyed and a third damaged.
Russia lost one Serna landing craft (7 May 2022) and several Tor launchers at Zmiinyi Island.
Russia lost a Mi-8 at Zmiinyi Island on 8 May 2022.
The tug Vasily Bekh, hit on 17 Jun 2022, is listed as destroyed by Oryx.
Ukraine claimed Pantsir-S1 systems and a radar were destroyed on Zmiinyi Island between 21 and 30 Jun 2022.
Ukraine lost the Mi-14 of Col. Ihor Bedzai on 7 May 2022 in the Zmiinyi Island fighting.
Ukraine lost about 10 men and a boat in the May 2022 assault on Zmiinyi Island.

The Russian garrison left Zmiinyi Island on 30 Jun 2022, without a Ukrainian landing.

text: Zmiinyi Island is about 0.2 km² in area.
Zmiinyi Island was not garrisoned after the Russian withdrawal of 30 Jun 2022.
The Ukrainian flag went up on Zmiinyi Island on 7 Jul 2022; its return had been announced on 4 Jul.
The cause of the 30 Jun 2022 Russian withdrawal from Zmiinyi Island is contested: Russia says it was goodwill; Ukraine, the UK and the Pentagon say it was forced.
In Jul 2021 the first Bayraktar TB2 was delivered to the Ukrainian Navy, bought partly as a Neptune spotter.
In Aug 2021 the first full Neptune system on a Tatra chassis was assembled for the Independence Day parade.
Neizhpapa later said that the first Neptune division would arrive only in spring 2022.
After 20 Feb 2022 the first state-ordered Neptune missiles left the Kyiv factory for Odesa.

About 03:00 on 24 Feb 2022 the Zmiinyi Island border post intercepted the "Russian warship" telling a civilian vessel that the waters around the island were mined; the alarm was raised and the marines took positions.

mentions.name: State Border Guard Service of Ukraine

text: At 06:00 on 24 Feb 2022 Russia made the first surrender call to the Zmiinyi Island garrison on Channel 16 (career, pension, "stay alive"), repeated every 15–20 minutes.
At 09:00 on 24 Feb 2022 the Russian calls to Zmiinyi Island turned to threats ("your chances of survival are zero") and the Vasily Bykov appeared on the horizon.

cites.quote: your chances of survival are zero

text: About 12:00 on 24 Feb 2022 the Moskva joined the Vasily Bykov off Zmiinyi Island; the Vasily Bykov's first salvo fell short into the sea.
After lunch on 24 Feb 2022 Russia struck Zmiinyi Island with about 3 hours of Su-27/Su-34 air strikes plus Moskva gunfire.
On the afternoon of 24 Feb 2022 two evacuation boats reached Zmiinyi Island, and only three civilians agreed to leave.
At 14:55 on 24 Feb 2022 the SBGS photographed the Moskva off Zmiinyi Island; Deineko showed it as the "last photo above water".

mentions.name: State Border Guard Service of Ukraine

text: About 18:00 on 24 Feb 2022 the reply "Russian warship, go f— yourself" was recorded on a phone at the mainland border headquarters from a radio relay.

mentions.name: State Border Guard Service of Ukraine

text: About 19:00 on 24 Feb 2022 contact with Zmiinyi Island was lost after another attack; Russian troops landed and captured the garrison and the civilians.
About 22:00 on 24 Feb 2022 the SBGS announced that Zmiinyi Island had been captured after naval and air bombardment.

claimants.name: State Border Guard Service of Ukraine

mentions.name: State Border Guard Service of Ukraine

text: At 00:48 on 25 Feb 2022 Ukrainska Pravda published the Zmiinyi Island radio audio.
The Zmiinyi Island audio was published alongside a false story, spread by Herashchenko, that 13 defenders had died.

observations.subject: false initial report of Zmiinyi defenders killed

text: By 26 Feb 2022 Ukraine made its first Neptune launches, from southern Odesa Oblast, at three Russian landing ships heading for Mykolaiv; there were no hits, but the ships turned back.
In the first Neptune launches (by 26 Feb 2022) the missiles were fired at about 120 m altitude to clear Odesa.
On the morning of 26 Feb 2022 the rescue ship Sapfir, sent to recover "bodies", was seized at Zmiinyi Island and the 21 aboard (crew, chaplains, a doctor) were captured.
On 28 Feb 2022 the Ukrainian Navy said the Zmiinyi defenders were alive and captive, having repulsed two attacks and run out of ammunition.
In Mar 2022 Luch specialists found a common faulty element in all the Neptune missiles and fixed it.
On 12 Mar 2022 a stamp design by Borys Groh was chosen by public vote for the 'Russian warship' stamp.
On 24 Mar 2022 the first prisoner swap freed the Sapfir crew and Zmiinyi servicemen; the Rada says 19.
On 29 Mar 2022 Roman Hrybov, freed in the swap, received a medal in Cherkasy.
Ukraine claimed a Neptune strike on the frigate Admiral Essen on 4 Apr 2022; a Russian court later dated it 2 Apr.
In Apr 2022 the Zmiinyi border-post commander Bohdan Hotskyi returned in a large prisoner swap.
On 12 Apr 2022 Ukrposhta issued 1 million "Russian warship…" stamps.
On 13 Apr 2022 a Neptune crew launched two missiles, with about 6 minutes' flight, at a large target about 120 km offshore.
Butusov gives the time of the 13 Apr 2022 Neptune launch at the Moskva as 14:10.
Ukrainska Pravda gives the time of the 13 Apr 2022 Neptune launch at the Moskva as about 16:00.
About 30 minutes after the 13 Apr 2022 hit, Russian frigates, missile boats, a reconnaissance ship and rescue vessels headed for the Moskva.

observations.subject: time before the rescue group sailed

text: At 18:52 on 13 Apr 2022 a SAR satellite image showed the Moskva with attending ships at 45°10′43″N 30°55′31″E.
At 20:42 on 13 Apr 2022 came the first public report that the Moskva was "hit by 2 Neptune missiles… burning… storm at sea".

cites.quote: hit by 2 Neptune missiles… burning… storm at sea

text: Odesa governor Marchenko confirmed the Neptune hit on the Moskva on the evening of 13 Apr 2022.
On the night of 13–14 Apr 2022 the Russian MoD said there was a fire and an ammunition detonation on the Moskva, the crew was evacuated, and the ship was towed toward Sevastopol.
Lithuanian defence minister Anušauskas said the Moskva sent an SOS at 01:05 on 14 Apr 2022, rolled at 01:14 and had sunk by about 03:00.
At 02:59 on 14 Apr 2022 a Wagner-linked Telegram channel said the Moskva was hit by Neptunes "from the coastline between Odesa and Nikolaev" while the ship's forces were "diverted" by a TB2.

cites.quote: from the coastline between Odesa and Nikolaev

text: At 12:43 on 14 Apr 2022 OC South said the Moskva was hit by a Neptune and that the storm and an ammunition explosion capsized it.
On the evening of 14 Apr 2022 the Russian MoD said the Moskva lost stability under tow and sank "in the stormy sea conditions".
On 15 Apr 2022 a US senior defence official said two Neptunes hit the Moskva, which was about 65 nmi south of Odesa when struck.
On 16 Apr 2022 the Russian MoD released video of Adm. Yevmenov with about 100 sailors, by The Insider's count.
On 18 Apr 2022 photos and a 3 s video of the listing, burning Moskva surfaced on Telegram.
On 22 Apr 2022 the Russian MoD gave the Moskva losses as 1 dead, 27 missing and 396 rescued.
On 22 Apr 2022 Danilov said only 58 of the Moskva's 510 crew were rescued.
On 22 Apr 2022 the Moskva wreck was entered as Ukrainian underwater cultural heritage No. 2064.
On 26 and 30 Apr 2022 Ukrainian coastal missile, artillery and TB2 strikes hit Zmiinyi Island: a command post, a Strela-10, a communications vehicle, a Repellent-1 EW system and three AA mounts.
At 04:38 and 04:51 on 2 May 2022 a TB2 hit two Russian Raptor patrol boats "at dawn", per Zaluzhnyi.
On 5 May 2022 US officials said the US identified the ship as the Moskva and helped confirm its location, but the decision to strike was Ukraine's.
On 6 May 2022 a TB2 destroyed a Tor on Zmiinyi Island.
On 7 May 2022 a TB2 hit a Serna landing craft as it unloaded a replacement Tor at Zmiinyi Island's only usable ramp; the wreck blocked the landing.
On 7 May 2022 two Ukrainian Su-27s toss-bombed Zmiinyi Island.
On 7 May 2022 Col. Ihor Bedzai's Mi-14 was shot down by a Russian fighter's missile during search and rescue at the Danube mouth.

In a HUR-led assault on Zmiinyi Island on 7–9 May 2022 (date contested), 4 Mi-24 and 4 Mi-8 (or eight Mi-8) and Hiurza-M boats landed, then withdrew under fire from a Tor lashed to a boat deck and from aviation.
notes: date contested (7 May vs night of 8–9 May)

text: Ukrainska Pravda says about 10 were killed and a boat was lost in the May 2022 HUR assault on Zmiinyi Island.
On 8 May 2022 a TB2 bombed a Russian Mi-8 unloading troops on Zmiinyi Island.
On 8 May 2022 two more Russian Raptor boats were hit near Zmiinyi Island.
Maxar imagery of 12 May 2022 shows a Serna manoeuvring under missile contrails and a crane barge at the sunken Serna off Zmiinyi Island.
On 12 May 2022 Ukraine claimed a hit on the Russian logistics ship Vsevolod Bobrov.
On 13 May 2022 HUR said a Pantsir and two Tor-M2 were on Zmiinyi Island, with S-300 or strike systems possible.
On 14 May 2022 HUR claimed only 8 of 40 Russian liaison officers sent to Zmiinyi Island returned alive.

observations.subject: liaison officers sent to the island

text: On 23 May 2022 the "Russian warship… IS DONE!" stamps (5 million) were cancelled by Zelensky and Neizhpapa.
On 17 Jun 2022 two Harpoons hit the Russian tug Vasily Bekh, reportedly carrying a Tor-M2KM, en route to Zmiinyi Island.

observations.subject: Harpoon hits on the Vasily Bekh

text: Russian reports said 10 of the 33 aboard the Vasily Bekh were missing and 23 injured after the 17 Jun 2022 strike.
On 20 Jun 2022 Ukrainian missile strikes on the occupied gas rigs (the "Boiko towers") destroyed 3 of 4, per Ukrainska Pravda.
On 21 Jun 2022 OC South announced the operation against Zmiinyi Island.
Planet imagery of 21 Jun 2022 shows three new scorch marks on Zmiinyi Island.
From 21 to 30 Jun 2022 Bohdana, CAESAR and Uragan fired on Zmiinyi Island from the shore near Vylkove (40 km), ferried nightly by Danube pontoon.
On 26 Jun 2022 a Ukrainian Su-24MR was lost on a Snake Island mission and both crew were killed.
On the night of 29–30 Jun 2022, after rocket and artillery strikes, the Russian garrison evacuated Zmiinyi Island in two high-speed boats, with the island burning.
On 30 Jun 2022 Bohdana fired 46 rounds at Zmiinyi Island (90 s flight), keeping its last four for a Russian pickup.

observations.subject: rounds kept back for the pickup

text: On 30 Jun 2022 Zaluzhnyi credited Bohdana for the Zmiinyi Island result.
On 30 Jun 2022 the Russian MoD called the Zmiinyi Island withdrawal a "goodwill gesture".
About 18:00 on 1 Jul 2022 two Russian Su-30 sorties dropped phosphorus bombs on the empty Zmiinyi Island.
On 4 Jul 2022 Humeniuk said the Zmiinyi operation was complete and the territory returned, with the flag "raised".
On 4 Jul 2022 Humeniuk also said no one would risk troops on Zmiinyi Island for a photo.
On 7 Jul 2022 (about 05:00 per the Russian MoD) a small Ukrainian party from a motorboat raised the flag on Zmiinyi Island; HUR and the MoD published photos.
Russia claimed a missile strike killed some of the Ukrainian flag party on Zmiinyi Island on 7 Jul 2022.
Ukraine said the flag party had left Zmiinyi Island before two Russian missiles hit the pier on 7 Jul 2022.
Ukrainian special forces cleared mines on Zmiinyi Island in July 2022.
On 3 Nov 2022 a Sevastopol court declared 17 missing Moskva sailors dead.
Zmiinyi Island prisoners were freed in stages beginning on 24 Nov 2022.
By Apr 2023, 40 Zmiinyi Island prisoners had been freed.
The last Zmiinyi Island prisoner, border guard Vitalii Hyrenko, was freed on 23 Jul 2025.
On 22 Jan 2026 a Moscow military court named Andrii Shubin of the 406th Artillery Brigade as responsible for the Moskva sinking and found 20 dead, 24 injured and 8 missing.
Zmiinyi Island sits at the south-western corner of Ukraine's territorial waters.
The centroid of Zmiinyi Island is at 45.2548, 30.2033; the island polygon is about 0.20 km² and about 590 × 570 m.
The Guardian gives Zmiinyi Island's area as about 16 ha.
Ukrainska Pravda describes Zmiinyi Island as "less than half the size of the Vatican".

cites.quote: less than half the size of the Vatican

text: Bile, at 45.2565, 30.2064, is the only settlement on Zmiinyi Island; its inhabitants were the lighthouse keeper, an assistant and service workers.
At 18:52 on 13 Apr 2022 the already burning Moskva was at 45.1787, 30.9251 (45°10′43.39″N 30°55′30.54″E), about 80 nmi south of Odesa, 50 nmi from the coast and east of Zmiinyi Island.
Ukrainian guns fired on Zmiinyi Island "from the shore near the city of Vylkove" (45.4031, 29.5831), 40 km from the island.

Sulina, Romania (45.1558, 29.6550), is the nearest Romanian port to Zmiinyi Island.
Zmiinyi Island is 34–35 km from the Danube mouth.
Zmiinyi Island is under 40 km in places from the nearest southern Odesa Oblast coast.

text: Zmiinyi Island is about 45 km from Romania.
Zmiinyi Island is about 143 km from Odesa (computed great-circle distance).

Sky News, via Novaya Gazeta Europe, gives the Moskva's distance from Zmiinyi Island as 46 km.
At 18:52 on 13 Apr 2022 the Moskva was about 146 km from Odesa (computed), against the "80 nmi" reported by Naval News.
A US official put the Moskva strike point at about 65 nmi (about 120 km) south of Odesa.

The Harpoon strike on the Vasily Bekh on 17 Jun 2022 was about 33 km east of Zmiinyi Island.

observations.subject: Vasily Bekh strike point east of the island

text: The Moskva wreck lies about 80 nmi from Odesa, 45–50 m deep; its hull is 186 m long.
Zmiinyi Island is bare rock with steep shores and no trees.
Zmiinyi Island is hard to dig into, so its shelters protect against splinters, not bombs.
A lighthouse stands on the southern point of Zmiinyi Island; the Su-27s used it as their aiming mark.
Zmiinyi Island has a pier and its "only operable boat ramp" on the north side, where the Serna wreck blocked landings.
On Zmiinyi Island the main building complex sits above the pier, and the east point held ammunition and fuel.
The radars, towers and antennas on Zmiinyi Island were destroyed on 24 Feb 2022.
Ukrainians counted more than 20 wrecked Russian vehicles on Zmiinyi Island afterwards.

observations.subject: wrecked Russian vehicles on the island

text: The wreckage on Zmiinyi Island included Pantsir-S1, Tor and fuel tankers.
The Danube-delta coast is low shoals and sand, so heavy guns had to come by pontoon, 3–4 h each way, and be winched ashore with a border-guard water crane.
Russian EW kept consumer drones from flying out to sea from the Danube-delta coast.
24 Feb 2022 was clear at Zmiinyi Island: at sunrise the sea was "turning … gold", with no enemy in sight until the Vasily Bykov appeared around 09:00.
Ukrainska Pravda says the weather on 13 Apr 2022 was "foul", with dense cloud a couple of km above the water hiding the sea from jets, TB2s and optical satellites.
The Ukrainian Navy says a "three-point storm" hampered Moskva damage control on 13–14 Apr 2022.
OC South said a storm helped capsize the Moskva.
Russia described the sea at the Moskva's sinking as "stormy".
Naval News puts the conditions at the Moskva on 13 Apr 2022 at waves of about 1 m and wind of about 14 kt.
The photos of the stricken Moskva, circulating by 18 Apr 2022, show daylight and calm seas.
Ukrainska Pravda says the storm eased on 14 Apr 2022, the day after the Neptune strike.
The 2 May 2022 Raptor kills at Zmiinyi Island were at 04:38 and 04:51, "at dawn".
The Ukrainian Navy's TB2s had IR cameras for night work.
The Ukrainian guns firing on Zmiinyi Island moved by night.

On 24 Feb 2022 the Zmiinyi Island garrison was about 80 troops: about 30 border guards of the Izmail Border Detachment post under Bohdan Hotskyi, 40+ marines of the 35th Marine Brigade, and a few Ground Forces soldiers and Air Force airmen.

observations.subject: border guards of the Izmail Border Detachment post

text: On 24 Feb 2022 the Zmiinyi Island garrison had small arms and AA guns but no heavy weapons.
Deineko counts 28 border guards among the 80 people captured on Zmiinyi Island, including civilians.

mentions.name: State Border Guard Service of Ukraine

text: Throughout Feb–Jul 2022 the Ukrainian Navy was commanded by Rear Adm. (later Vice Adm.) Oleksiy Neizhpapa.
Dmytro Pletenchuk was the Ukrainian Navy spokesman.
The Neptune RK-360 coastal battery comprises a mobile command post, launchers and transport-loaders on Tatra chassis; it can fire up to 24 missiles at 3–5 s intervals and takes 15 min to deploy.

metric_new.label: Interval between launches in a salvo
Time to deploy a system for firing

text: In Feb–Apr 2022 the Neptune battery had only a "basic" radar of about 18 km range, and its crew had been trained by Luch.
The Neptune unit that struck the Moskva is not named in Ukrainian sources; a Russian court blames the 406th Artillery Brigade, commanded by Andrii Shubin.
The Ukrainian Navy's TB2s in Apr–Jun 2022 were late-production aircraft with an IR camera, an anti-jam antenna and MAM-C/MAM-L munitions.
The Navy TB2s were used for strike, spotting and fire adjustment, and filmed the Su-27 raid and the Vasily Bekh strike.
The Ukrainian Air Force flew a Su-27 pair on a toss-bombing raid on Zmiinyi Island on 7 May 2022.
The Ukrainian Air Force flew Su-24/Su-24MR raids on Zmiinyi Island in May–June 2022, losing one Su-24MR on 26 Jun.
Ukrainian naval aviation flew Mi-14 search and rescue; Col. Ihor Bedzai, deputy commander for naval aviation, was killed on 7 May 2022.

The HUR assault force for Zmiinyi Island in early May 2022, planned by Kyrylo Budanov, had 4 Mi-24 and 4 Mi-8 (Zavhorodnii says eight Mi-8 plus special forces), Hiurza-M armoured boats and a Mi-14 on standby.
The aim of the early-May 2022 HUR assault was to destroy equipment and block the bays on Zmiinyi Island, not to hold the island.

From 21 to 30 Jun 2022 Ukrainian coastal artillery against Zmiinyi Island comprised the single Bohdana 155 mm SPG prototype (gunner Yevhen Grushovets), CAESAR and Uragan MLRS, coordinated by OC South.
Ukraine's coastal Harpoons were ground launchers from Denmark with US missiles, confirmed in late May 2022 and first used in combat on 17 Jun 2022.
The July 2022 Ukrainian return party to Zmiinyi Island comprised the 73rd Naval Special Operations Centre (route, underwater work), deminers and a HUR flag party.
The cruiser Moskva was a Project 1164 Slava-class ship and the Black Sea Fleet flagship: 186.4 m long, 11,490 t full load, 32 kt.
The Moskva carried 16 P-1000 Vulkan missiles, 64 S-300F Fort missiles (8 × 8), 40 Osa-M, a twin AK-130 and 6 AK-630.
The Moskva was the Black Sea Fleet's only S-300F ship.
Anušauskas put the Moskva's crew at 485, including 66 officers.
The US put the Moskva's crew at 510.
The Moskva's commanding officer was Capt. 1st rank Anton Kuprin; his fate is contested.
The patrol ship Vasily Bykov is a Project 22160 ship, "the newest patrol boat".
Russian aviation over Zmiinyi Island on 24 Feb 2022 was Su-27 and Su-34.
Later in the Zmiinyi Island campaign Russian Su-30s shot down Bedzai's Mi-14.
Russian Su-30s dropped phosphorus on Zmiinyi Island on 1 Jul 2022.
The Russian garrison on Zmiinyi Island (Feb–Jun 2022) was a landing party ("paratroopers" in Ukrainska Pravda; Russian marines took the Sapfir); about 100 soldiers lived aboard the Sapfir.

observations.subject: Russian soldiers living aboard the Sapfir

text: HUR claims a Sevastopol special unit and liaison officers were among the Russian dead on Zmiinyi Island.
Russian air defence on Zmiinyi Island (Mar–Jun 2022) included several Tor systems, replaced repeatedly; HUR said two Tor-M2.
Russian air defence on Zmiinyi Island also included Pantsir-S1, Strela-10 and ZU-23-2.
Ukrainska Pravda claimed a Buk was on Zmiinyi Island.
notes: the forces row attaches no specific source to the UP Buk claim; cited to the row's campaign reference

text: Russia had a Repellent-1 counter-drone EW system and a radar on Zmiinyi Island.
An MLRS was claimed on Zmiinyi Island on 1 Jun 2022.
Danilov said Russia had a radio-reconnaissance post on Zmiinyi Island watching Odesa Oblast, Bessarabia and Transnistria.
The Russian supply fleet for Zmiinyi Island included Raptor boats (the Black Sea Fleet had 7).

observations.subject: Raptor boats in the Black Sea Fleet

text: The Russian supply fleet for Zmiinyi Island also used Serna and Dyugon landing craft, Project 22870 rescue tugs (including the Vasily Bekh, and tugs with Pantsirs on the stern), the Vsevolod Bobrov and a crane barge.
Ropucha landing ships stopped coming near Zmiinyi Island after late April 2022.
The occupied "Boiko towers" gas rigs (Feb – 20 Jun 2022) were fitted with weapons, air defence and jamming, and formed part of a sea "line of control" with Zmiinyi Island and the Moskva.
From Feb to Apr 2022 the Moskva knit Zmiinyi Island, the gas rigs and the fleet into one air-defence system.
After 14 Apr 2022 the big Russian ships pulled back out of Neptune range.
After the Moskva's loss, Zmiinyi Island held on with point defence brought in by small craft that TB2s hunted.
In June 2022 Harpoons and coastal guns made resupply of Zmiinyi Island impossible.

On 24 Feb 2022 Russia's radio ultimatum to Zmiinyi Island moved from persuasion to threats every 15–20 min on Channel 16, timed to the ships' appearance on the horizon, followed by gunfire and then air strikes.
The R-360 Neptune is a subsonic sea-skimmer that flies 3–10 m above the water and is aimed just above the waterline, with a 150 kg warhead and up to 300 km range.
In February 2022 the Neptune missiles had to be flown at about 120 m over Odesa, which may explain why they failed.
On 13 Apr 2022 the Neptune battery's ordinary radar reportedly saw the Moskva at about 120 km because low cloud ducted the beam.
Neizhpapa says the first Neptune hit the Moskva's galley above the engine room and the second the stern, after which AK-630 ammunition exploded.
Parry, an outside analyst, puts one or two hits on the Moskva below the aft Vulkan tubes, with fuel spreading the fire.
The Moskva's six AK-630s and Rum Tub ESM should have given about 2 minutes of warning of the Neptunes.
There is no record of the Moskva using chaff, jamming or manoeuvre against the Neptunes on 13 Apr 2022.
Naval News explains the Moskva's failure to defend itself by poor alertness and training.
Ukrainska Pravda says the Moskva's air defences were "probably" not switched on.
Damage control on the Moskva failed within hours.
The Russian court cites a six-hour rescue effort for the Moskva.
Ukrainian officials and the Wagner-linked Telegram channel claimed a TB2 acted as a decoy or spotter in the Moskva strike, as did Ukrainska Pravda in Nov 2022.
The TB2 decoy role in the Moskva strike has been called "unlikely" (Forbes) and "unrealistic" (Naval News).
Ukrainska Pravda in Dec 2022 says the TB2 operators refused to fly under the cloud on 13 Apr 2022.
On treeless Zmiinyi Island, SHORAD with no area cover and no fighter cover let slow, low-signature TB2s kill the Tor, Strela-10 and ZU-23-2.
The TB2s then hit the boats bringing replacement air defence to Zmiinyi Island, which became the island's real weak point.
Russia answered the TB2s at Zmiinyi Island with a Tor fired from a boat deck, Pantsirs on tug sterns and EW.
By June 2022 TB2s could not close inside 28–30 km of Zmiinyi Island.

observations.subject: TB2 closest approach to the island

text: Ukrainian Su-27s toss-bombed Zmiinyi Island by coming in under lighthouse height, popping up and lobbing high-drag bombs while dropping flares.
Ukraine used Neptune and Harpoon against Russian resupply ships; the goal "was not the destruction of the garrison, but the complete severance of its supply lines".

cites.quote: was not the destruction of the garrison, but the complete severance of its supply lines

text: Naval News judges a tug "a higher-value target than the warships".

cites.quote: a higher-value target than the warships

text: Bohdana (450 test rounds to 42 km) and CAESAR fired at maximum range from beach positions about 40 km from Zmiinyi Island.
The Ukrainian guns firing on Zmiinyi Island were camouflaged, and metal decoys hung in the trees made Russian radar "glow the whole coast".
The Ukrainian guns used a shoot-and-hide rotation against Zmiinyi Island: CAESAR, then Uragan, then Bohdana, with brass cleared away.
Fire on Zmiinyi Island was adjusted by Mavic/Matrix drones to about 20 m, with TB2 video going to OC South HQ.
Bohdana's barrel seals burned out after three shots, and CAESAR leaked oil after 20.

observations.subject: Bohdana rounds before barrel seals burned out

text: On both sides the narrative was itself a weapon: the 13-dead myth, the stamps, Russia's "accident/storm" story and the "goodwill gesture".

measure: island SHORAD (Tor, Strela-10, ZU-23-2) on Zmiinyi Island
effect: TB2s killed the island's point air defence
rationale: Without area cover or fighter cover on a treeless rock, the short-range systems were exposed to slow, low-signature TB2s.

measure: small-craft resupply of Zmiinyi Island's air defence
effect: replacement boats became the island's real weak point
rationale: After the Moskva was gone, Russia brought point defence in by small craft, and the TB2s hunted them.

counter: boat-deck Tor, tug-stern Pantsirs and EW
effect: by June TB2s could not close inside 28–30 km of the island
rationale: Russia answered the TB2 attrition with ship-mounted air defence and EW around the island.

measure: Russian radar watching the Danube-delta coast
effect: decoys made Russian radar 'glow the whole coast'
rationale: Metal decoys in the trees added false returns that hid the guns' firing positions.

measure: consumer drones flown out to sea
effect: kept consumer drones from flying out to sea
rationale: Russian EW around the island denied consumer drones over the water.

measure: Moskva shipborne air defence (AK-630, Rum Tub ESM)
effect: two hits; no record of chaff, jamming or manoeuvre in response
rationale: A sea-skimmer at 3–10 m gave about 2 min of warning at best, and the crew reportedly failed to react.

measure: sea resupply of the Russian garrison on Zmiinyi Island
effect: resupply became impossible by June; Russia withdrew on 30 Jun
rationale: The aim was the complete severance of the garrison's supply lines rather than its destruction.

text: On 24 Feb 2022 Hotskyi split his men across shelters on Zmiinyi Island so that one bomb could not kill them all, and one old border guard ran back to stay with him.
On the mainland on 24 Feb 2022 a phone recorded the Zmiinyi reply off a radio relay, with someone whispering "what, 'go f— yourself' too?"

mentions.name: State Border Guard Service of Ukraine

text: On 26 Feb 2022 chaplains, a doctor and the crew sailed on the Sapfir with body bags to recover "the 13 dead"; Russian marines boarded, made everyone kneel and showed them a video that everyone on Zmiinyi Island was alive and captured.

On 13 Apr 2022 the Neptune battery's basic radar showed a huge contact about 120 km out that it should not have been able to see; after "several minutes of pondering and consultations" two Neptunes were launched, followed by about six minutes of not knowing.

cites.quote: several minutes of pondering and consultations

text: After the Neptune hits on 13 Apr 2022 the Moskva turned at full speed for the Boiko towers, and four ships converged on it.
A tug hosed the listing Moskva; its life rafts were gone.
The Moskva sent an SOS at 01:05 on 14 Apr 2022, rolled at 01:14 and was under by about 03:00.
By the calm sea of 14 Apr 2022 there was only the "heavy black silhouette" of the Moskva going down.
On 2 May 2022 a TB2 struck two zigzagging Raptors 13 minutes apart.
On 7 May 2022 a Serna lowered its ramp at Zmiinyi Island with a Tor's radar still turning, and the TB2 bomb arrived.
On 7 May 2022 two Su-27s skimmed in from the south past the Zmiinyi lighthouse and toss-bombed the buildings.
In the night assault on Zmiinyi Island (7–9 May 2022) eight helicopters and armoured boats ran in; a Tor lashed to a boat deck opened up and the assault pulled back.
Over the coast during the May 2022 assault, the standby rescue helicopter flown by Col. Bedzai was shot down.
TB2 video of 17 Jun 2022 shows the second Harpoon arriving seconds after the first fireball on the Vasily Bekh.
On 30 Jun 2022 Bohdana fired shell after shell at Zmiinyi Island, 90 seconds each to the island, waiting for the barrel to cool, and held four rounds back for the pickup boats.

observations.subject: rounds held back for the pickup boats

text: On 30 Jun 2022, with Zmiinyi Island burning, the last Russians left by speedboat.
A day after the Russian withdrawal, Russia flew phosphorus runs over Zmiinyi Island.
At dawn on 7 Jul 2022 a motorboat brought a flag to Zmiinyi Island reading "Russian warship, remember forever – Snake Island is Ukraine!!!"

cites.quote: Russian warship, remember forever – Snake Island is Ukraine!!!

text: On 24 Feb 2022 the Zmiinyi Island garrison decided to hold rather than surrender, ignoring a day of Russian offers and threats.
Of the civilians on Zmiinyi Island on 24 Feb 2022, only three took the two evacuation boats.
The Ukrainian Navy says the Zmiinyi defenders repulsed two attacks and could not go on without ammunition after their communications were destroyed.
In Kyiv the government reported the Zmiinyi defenders dead and announced Hero titles; that error drove the decision to send the Sapfir.
On 26 Feb 2022 Ukraine sent the Sapfir on the belief that the Zmiinyi garrison was dead and that a body-recovery deal existed; the result was 21 more captives.
In Mar 2022, after the February misses, the Neptune system's operator ordered every missile checked, and Luch found and fixed a common fault.
Sources split over whether the common Neptune fault found in Mar 2022 was sabotage.
On 13 Apr 2022 the Neptune operator launched after minutes of consultation, on a radar contact at extreme range.
US officials say the US identified the target as the Moskva and helped confirm its location but was not told of the strike in advance.
Ukrainska Pravda in Nov 2022 says NATO, including a P-8, confirmed "a certain object in a certain square" before the Moskva strike.

cites.quote: a certain object in a certain square

text: Ukrainian military sources (in Ukrainska Pravda, Dec 2022) and the Navy spokesman (2025) say Ukraine found the Moskva itself.
Neizhpapa says he expected it would take at least six Neptunes to sink the Moskva.

observations.subject: Neptunes expected to sink the Moskva

text: On 13–14 Apr 2022 a Russian rescue group sailed within about 30 min; the Moskva was towed toward Sevastopol rather than abandoned at once, and people were taken off "from lunch to morning".

observations.subject: time before the rescue group sailed

text: The Russian rescue effort for the Moskva lasted about 6 h.
Russia publicly denied that the Moskva was struck.
From late April 2022 the big Russian ships kept a standoff from Odesa and the Ropucha landing ships stopped coming to Zmiinyi Island.
Russia chose to keep feeding SHORAD to Zmiinyi Island by small craft, which is what the TB2s hunted.
ISW predicted that after the Moskva's loss Russia would have to add point defence to Zmiinyi Island or withdraw.

claimants.name: Institute for the Study of War

mentions.name: Institute for the Study of War

text: Budanov's plan for the early-May 2022 assault was to land, destroy equipment and block the bays; the orders were explicitly not to hold Zmiinyi Island, to avoid leaving a target.
The early-May 2022 assault on Zmiinyi Island was aborted under fire from the boat-borne Tor.
Zavhorodnii says the early-May 2022 assault was aborted under fire from aviation and naval air defence.
The early-May 2022 assault on Zmiinyi Island was criticised inside Ukraine, with some calling Budanov "a butcher" chasing a 9 May flag.
Ukrainska Pravda's intelligence sources put the losses of the early-May 2022 assault at about 10 people and a boat, and say half the equipment was destroyed.
In late May – June 2022 Ukraine decided to "oust the Russians … with massive missile and artillery strikes" on Zmiinyi Island, using the newly arrived Western 155 mm guns from the delta coast.

cites.quote: oust the Russians … with massive missile and artillery strikes

text: Ukrainian coastal missile and artillery forces were tasked with preventing any resupply of Zmiinyi Island.
On 30 Jun 2022 Russia withdrew from Zmiinyi Island and framed it as goodwill toward a UN grain corridor.
Russian milbloggers had criticised the command for not retreating from Zmiinyi Island sooner.
After withdrawing, Russia bombed Zmiinyi Island with phosphorus, which Ukraine read as denying the abandoned equipment.
In July 2022 Humeniuk said "no one will risk people for the sake of a photo", explaining why Ukraine would not garrison Zmiinyi Island.

cites.quote: No one will risk people for the sake of a photo

text: Instead of garrisoning Zmiinyi Island, a brief Ukrainian special-forces landing after demining raised the flag and left in July 2022.
The Russian MoD (Konashenkov) said 82 Ukrainian servicemen on Zmiinyi Island surrendered voluntarily, signed pledges and would be released.
Russia claimed it sank 6 of 16 Ukrainian boats that attacked Zmiinyi Island on 25 Feb 2022, and accused the US of helping.

observations.subject: Ukrainian boats claimed to have attacked

text: The US denied Russia's claim that it helped a Ukrainian boat attack on Zmiinyi Island on 25 Feb 2022.
On 14 Apr 2022 the Russian MoD said a fire on the Moskva detonated ammunition, the fire was contained and the crew was evacuated.
Later on 14 Apr 2022 the Russian MoD said the Moskva "lost stability … in the stormy sea conditions" under tow and sank, with no mention of a strike.

cites.quote: lost stability … in the stormy sea conditions

text: On 16 Apr 2022 the Russian MoD showed Adm. Yevmenov meeting about 100 Moskva crew.
On 22 Apr 2022 the Russian MoD gave the Moskva losses as 1 dead, 27 missing and 396 rescued.
A Sevastopol court declared 17 Moskva sailors dead in Nov 2022.
In Jan 2026 a Moscow court acknowledged the Ukrainian missile, named Shubin, found 20 dead, 24 injured and 8 missing on the Moskva, and claimed 2.2 bn roubles.
Russian state-TV figures criticised the navy over the Moskva, and some blamed Norwegian missiles or US electronics.
Russia sent the 1915 salvage ship Kommuna to the Moskva wreck.
The Russian MoD claimed it repelled the May 2022 assault on Zmiinyi Island and killed "more than 50" paratroopers.
The Russian MoD claimed every Ukrainian drone and missile attack on Zmiinyi Island in June 2022 was defeated.
ISW said the Russian claim of defeating every June 2022 attack on Zmiinyi Island was made "despite considerable evidence to the contrary".

cites.quote: despite considerable evidence to the contrary

mentions.name: Institute for the Study of War

text: Russian media gave 10 missing and 23 injured on the Vasily Bekh after the 17 Jun 2022 strike.
On 30 Jun 2022 the Russian MoD said its tasks on Zmiinyi Island were "completed" and that the withdrawal was a "goodwill gesture" so as not to obstruct UN grain-corridor efforts.
Russian milbloggers followed the MoD's 'goodwill' line on Zmiinyi Island and ignored the strikes.
The US DoD saw "no credence" in Russia's goodwill claim for the Zmiinyi Island withdrawal.
On 7 Jul 2022 the Russian MoD said a 05:00 flag landing on Zmiinyi Island was hit by missiles, "killing some of the Ukrainian troops".

cites.quote: killing some of the Ukrainian troops

text: Ukraine denied any deaths in the 7 Jul 2022 flag landing on Zmiinyi Island.
